sources.title: Raman Sanyal, Grassmann Orbitopes, Oberwolfach Report 13/2015
sources.inspection: Printed pp.708–709; PDF48–49. Reinspected local extracted passage.
sources.scope_interface: Exact problem; affine degree at most one on oriented unit real Grassmannian. n≤7 computational evidence.

sources.title: Reese Harvey and H. Blaine Lawson Jr., Calibrated geometries, Acta Math.148 (1982), 47–157
sources.inspection: Printed p.68; PDF22. Reinspected Question6.5 and equation6.6 in local text and web primary PDF extraction.
sources.scope_interface: Pointwise/local norm-completion question; not a universal affirmative theorem.

sources.title: Hamza Fawzi, The Set of Separable States has no Finite Semidefinite Representation Except in Dimension 3×2, CMP386 (2021),1319–1335
sources.inspection: Printed pp.1319–1322; PDF1–4. Definition and Theorem1 reread. Whole PDF extraction keyword-searched for Grassmann, calibrat, Slater, fermion, with no matches.
sources.scope_interface: Exact external obstruction: arbitrary finite projected Hermitian spectrahedra; Sep(3,3) expressly included.

sources.title: Raman Sanyal, Frank Sottile, Bernd Sturmfels, Orbitopes
sources.inspection: PDF pp.31–35, especially Theorem7.6 p.34 and final paragraph p.35; introduction and Question9 checked.
sources.scope_interface: Only nonspectrahedral result for G3,6; final paragraph explicitly leaves projected representability unresolved as of that paper.

sources.title: Philipp Rostalski, SDP Relaxations for the Grassmann Orbitope
sources.inspection: Slides12–21; PDF23–36. Affine-form convention PDF23–24; numerical evidence PDF32; Harvey–Lawson formulation PDF35.
sources.scope_interface: TH1 exactness proved for k=2; higher-k evidence numerical; explicitly affine SOS supporting functions.

sources.title: John Schliemann, J.Ignacio Cirac, Marek Kuś, Maciej Lewenstein, Daniel Loss, Quantum correlations in two-fermion systems
sources.inspection: Printed022303-3 to022303-4; PDF3–4, Definition1 and Sl1 discussion.
sources.scope_interface: Exact established intermediate convex body: Slater-number-one states, convex hull of rank-one projectors on simple two-fermion states.

sources.title: K.Eckert, J.Schliemann, D.Bruß, M.Lewenstein, Quantum Correlations in Systems of Indistinguishable Particles
sources.inspection: Printed pp.104–105 and110–111; PDF17–18 and23–24; Lemma4.1, Definition5.1, Theorem5.1.
sources.scope_interface: Confirms Slater convex-hull definition and small-four-mode concurrence criterion. No all-size finite LMI theorem inferred.

sources.title: Nisarga Paul, Haimeng Zhao, David D.Dai, Learning the closest Slater determinant
sources.version: arXiv:2607.20623v1,22July2026; no journal reference on primary record at inspection
sources.inspection: PDF pp.8,15–17, Theorem4, AppendixA.2, Figure7, equations(A17)–(A32). PDF16 rendered and visually checked. Whole text keyword-searched.
sources.scope_interface: Close component match: opposite-spin wedge isometry and positive-observable support-function equality. Computational-hardness theorem, not a Grassmann calibration/no-finite-lift theorem.

sources.title: Renato G.Bettiol, Mario Kummer, Ricardo A.E.Mendes, Convex Algebraic Geometry of Curvature Operators
sources.inspection: PDF pp.6–7 and15–17; Corollary4.2 and Remark4.3 p.17.
sources.scope_interface: No-shadow theorem for nonnegative quadratic forms on real Gr(k,n). Orbit representation Sym²(ΛᵏRⁿ), not the degree-one oriented Plücker body.

sources.title: Tim Kobert, Claus Scheiderer, Spectrahedral representation of polar orbitopes
sources.inspection: PDF p.7 §4.1 and Theorem4.2, plus abstract. Publisher primary webpage confirms same statements.
sources.scope_interface: Positive theorem assumes polar representation; §4.1 distinguishes nonspectrahedral G3,6 from other nonprojected-representable orbitopes. No theorem covering arbitrary Grassmann representation.

sources.title: Claus Scheiderer, Spectrahedral shadows
sources.inspection: PDF pp.15–17, Theorem4.23 and Corollaries4.24–4.25. Whole text keyword-searched for Grassmann/calibrat/separab/Fawzi/orbit.
sources.scope_interface: General existence of polynomial images without lifts and nonnegative-form cone obstruction; no theorem directly specifying frozen Grassmann embedding.

sources.title: José Ignacio Burgos Gil, Walter Gubler, Philipp Jell, Klaus Künnemann, A comparison of positivity in complex and tropical toric geometry
sources.scope_interface: Classical real(p,p)-form/Hermitian-form isomorphism and strongly-positive decomposable generators; supports established background of projector bridge, no no-lift conclusion.
